notes: Closed fixture for the T0275 store-crash-resume contract: pinned resume receipts and surviving logs computed by the reference engine over linked WAL logs; malformed rows cover every failure class with a single-locus minimal repair; rollback rows prove a rejected resume leaves the exact supplied log and request bit-identical before the valid follow-up resume removes exactly the torn tail.
